commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

pointer.description: A project or area folder pointer bank:org/project/[area/], whose flat memories may be split into authored topics.

propertyNames.description: A topic's name: a lower-case slug, the folder under memories/ its memories nest in.

items.description: A memory's name: a lower-case slug of at most 60 characters, its file's name (<name>.md) and unique in its bank; [[name]] links it.

topics.description: Authored topics mapped to their one-liner and memory names. Existing declarations remain; each selected memory moves one topic level deeper without changing its file.
